episode.title: Building A Mushroom House From Scratch! 🛠️✨

synopsis: A whimsical fairy-tale mushroom cottage with a carved wood stem and cap-shaped clay roof is constructed in a mossy forest clearing.

shots.prompt:
CAMERA A, CHAIN BREAK: open a fresh exterior scene in a locked-off tripod wide shot, with a slow zoom as its single camera move. Grade an empty lot, lay out road, fence and landscaping first, then mark the foundation. The builder arrives with materials.

Lush mossy forest glade surrounded by tall pine trees. The builder grades moist soil, installs circular stone footing slabs, and arranges thick cedar logs across the site.

CAMERA A, CHAINED: continue from shot 1's final frame in the same locked-off tripod framing, with a slow zoom as its single camera move. Raise foundation, walls and roof frame inside that same composition with accelerating timelapse energy and satisfying material flow.

Thick curved timber logs rise to form a flared stem wall frame. Layered birch plywood sheets and flexible clay tiles shape an overhang roof resembling a giant mushroom cap.

CAMERA A, CHAINED: continue from shot 2's final frame in the same locked-off tripod framing, with a slow zoom as its single camera move. Finish cladding, roof, paint, exterior lighting and landscaping until the completed exterior stands clearly in frame.

Deep red clay shingles cover the domed roof cap, trimmed with white decorative plaster dots. Terracotta plaster coats the exterior stem wall alongside an arched timber front door.

CAMERA B, CHAIN BREAK: open a fresh interior wide scene on a locked-off tripod, with a slow zoom as its single camera move. Build interior walls, lay flooring, install utilities and lighting infrastructure, carrying the exterior's materials and design language inside.

Interior circular room with exposed timber joists overhead. Hand-laid cobblestone flooring spreads smoothly while rustic wood partitioning walls and a stone hearth take shape.

CAMERA B, CHAINED: continue from shot 4's final frame in the same locked-off tripod framing, with a slow zoom as its single camera move. Install furniture and decor, bring the lighting up, and finish the interior until it looks ready to live in.

Custom carved wooden furniture, built-in shelving, plush woven textiles, and warm Edison bulb fixtures adorn the interior. Soft golden light fills the cozy fairy-tale living space.

REVEAL TOUR, CHAINED FROM CAMERA B: continue from shot 5's final frame with the tripod lock released for one unbroken move that begins inside, passes through a door or window, and settles on a wide exterior of the finished structure while the builder keeps working.

Unbroken camera path moves from the glowing hearth interior, gliding out the round wooden doorway, sweeping out to showcase the fully lit mushroom house glowing in the forest twilight.

music: Acoustic wood percussion, marimba, and light hand drums maintain a steady rhythmic groove matching step-by-step woodworking. Sound tapers to a quiet hum as final interior decorations settle, then swells into a bright warm acoustic guitar melody across the full structure reveal, fading gently.
